$description: Dark tints. Palette D adds one new primitive: deepGreenPage, for the dark bg.page direction (deep green, no pink). Everything else in this file is unchanged.

rustLight.$description: brand.link — unchanged by Palette D (already the value Palette D wants for dark link).

magentaLight.$description: Unused for focus.ring under Palette D (dark focus.ring now uses tealStrong below) — kept for any other consumer.

plumLight.$description: Unused for text.heading under Palette D (dark heading now uses sageLight, from the main token file) — kept for any other consumer.

deepGreenPage.$description: New Palette D primitive: dark theme bg.page. Deep green direction, replacing the reused charcoal — no pink in dark mode.

tealSubtle.$description: status.infoSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

tealStrong.$description: status.onInfo foreground (dark). Also reused as dark focus.ring under Palette D.

amberSubtle.$description: status.warningSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

amberStrong.$description: status.onWarning foreground (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

crimsonSubtle.$description: status.dangerSubtle fill (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.

crimsonStrong.$description: status.onDanger foreground (dark). Pending Palette D recompute.
